evidence_review.wild_diet: direct T. graeca graeca fecal-analysis evidence; Malva parviflora was one of five main preferred plants accounting collectively for 70% of identified dietary material in the 2006 Morocco study. A later Souss Valley study also reports M. parviflora among consumed plants.
evidence_review.veterinary_toxicity: species-specific equine and ovine reports describe suspected/probable toxicosis after heavy grazing; proposed mechanisms include cyclopropene fatty acids. These are mammalian data and do not establish Testudo toxicity.
evidence_review.counterevidence: 2022 rat study of isolated leaf/fruit mucilage found no acute toxicity at 5 g/kg, but this was an extracted mucilage preparation, not whole fresh plant and not a tortoise study.
evidence_review.interpretation: The tortoise feeding evidence and mammalian veterinary toxicity cannot be collapsed into a simple safe/unsafe conclusion. Testudo-specific oral safety evidence remains absent.

candidates.publication_blocker: T. graeca graeca의 직접 야생섭식 근거가 강하지만, M. parviflora의 포유류 수의독성 사례와 충돌한다. 2022년 쥐의 추출 점액질 안전성은 생초 전체의 육지거북 안전성을 입증하지 않는다. Testudo/파충류 경구자료 확보 전 A/B 공개 승격 금지.

assessment_readiness.required_next_evidence: Malva parviflora 생초/실제 섭식부위의 파충류 또는 Testudo 경구 안전자료; 가능하면 cyclopropene fatty acid와 실제 섭식량의 관계 자료

candidates.taxonomy_authority: Kew Plants of the World Online
candidates.publication_blocker: 정확한 종의 잎·식물에 점막 자극 위험신호가 있고 전문 사육 DB도 급여 회피를 권고한다. 농축 정유 세포독성을 생잎 경구독성으로 과장하지 않되, Testudo 직접 안전자료가 없으므로 A/B 승격 금지. 공개 D 판정 후보로 별도 assessment 검토 가능.

evidence_review.species_specific_hazard: Exact-species extension references report leaf/plant volatile-oil, tannic-acid and gallic-acid related skin or mucosal irritation in humans/livestock and poor livestock forage value.
evidence_review.concentrated_extract: A 2008 Korean study found cytotoxicity of steam-distilled essential oil from aerial Erigeron canadensis in HaCaT cells; this is concentrated essential oil in vitro and is not equivalent to fresh-leaf oral toxicity.
evidence_review.husbandry_evidence: The Tortoise Table lists Conyza canadensis / Erigeron canadensis as Do not Feed, citing irritant properties, possible cadmium uptake on contaminated soil, and poor livestock palatability.
evidence_review.Testudo_directness: No sufficiently verified direct Testudo feeding/safety study is present in the canonical evidence set.
evidence_review.interpretation: Species-specific hazard signals plus specialist husbandry avoidance justify conservative handling, while concentrated-oil cytotoxicity must not be presented as a fresh-plant tortoise toxic dose.

assessment_readiness.required_next_evidence: D 판정 작성 시 종특이 자극성 자료와 Tortoise Table 전문 사육근거를 분리 인용하고, 정유 in-vitro 자료는 보조 위험신호로만 표시

candidates.publication_blocker: M. minima는 가축·초식동물의 사료/방목 식물로 사용되는 근거가 반복되지만 Testudo 직접섭식·경구 안전량 자료가 없다. Medicago 속 사포닌 정보를 종특이 독성으로 전이하지 않으며 A/B 공개 판정은 보류.

evidence_review.wild_diet: No direct Testudo graeca feeding record established in the reviewed evidence set.
evidence_review.herbivore_use: Species is documented as forage/animal food and as a grazed species; GRIN records animal-food forage use, and field/pasture sources document grazing by sheep/cattle.
evidence_review.phytochemistry: Exact-species studies document substantial phenolic variation among roots, stems, leaves and seeds; Medicago genus is saponin-rich, but the reviewed 12-species saponin study did not include M. minima, so genus-level saponin information is not treated as species-specific toxicity.
evidence_review.interpretation: Herbivore forage use supports ecological plausibility but does not establish Testudo safety or a feeding grade.

assessment_readiness.required_next_evidence: M. minima의 Testudo/파충류 직접섭식 또는 전문 사육자료, 또는 정확한 종·부위의 초식척추동물 경구 안전자료

evidence_review.interpretation: Do not transfer genus-level cyanogenic risk automatically to T. campestre, but do not treat absence of species-specific evidence as proof of safety.
